activity.role: UNITA leader and de facto ruler
activity.notes: Savimbi was not head of the internationally recognized Republic of Angola. He founded UNITA in 1966 and, after Angolan independence in 1975, led a rival political-military authority that at various times governed extensive territories, especially in southern and central Angola, until his death on 22 February 2002. ATLAS therefore uses 'UNITA-controlled territories in Angola' rather than falsely assigning him national rule over Angola.

sources.title: Savimbi, Jonas Malheiro — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Savimbi as founder of UNITA in 1966, principal opponent of the MPLA government, controller of southern areas by the late 1980s, and a central figure in the civil war until his death in 2002.

sources.title: Jonás Savimbi — CIDOB
sources.citation_text: CIDOB gives Savimbi's leadership of UNITA from 13 March 1966 to his death on 22 February 2002.
